system.name: AnyEdit
system.one_liner: A 2.5M-pair instruction-based image-editing dataset covering 25 editing types in five groups, used to train a task-aware diffusion editor.

content.variant_note: five tinted bands of editing-type example cards beside a sunburst of the type distribution
content.argues: The dataset covers a wide, grouped catalogue of editing types, from local and global edits to camera moves, implicit edits and visual-reference edits, with an even spread of data.
content.subject: Example editing pairs with instructions for 25 editing types in five coloured groups, and a sunburst chart of how the dataset splits across groups and types.

lessons.what_to_learn: Give each category of a taxonomy one pastel colour and use it twice: for a tinted band of example cards (instruction plus before and after pair) and for the matching wedges of a sunburst, so examples and statistics read as one picture.
lessons.suits: Datasets or benchmarks with many task types that can each be shown by one input-output example, plus a distribution of the data over them.

evidence: Caption: image editing tasks are grouped into five classes by editing capability, each shown in its own coloured area.
Section 3: the data distribution of AnyEdit is shown in Fig. 1(b), a broad variety of edit types across domains.
Section 3: five main categories with local, global, camera movement, implicit and visual editing types.

summary: AnyEdit is a 2.5M-pair instruction-based image-editing dataset with 25 editing types in five groups, plus a diffusion model trained on it. Figure 1 is a dashboard. Panel (a) stacks five pastel bands for local, visual, camera movement, global and implicit editing; each band holds one card per type with the source photo, a dashed divider, the edited result and the instruction underneath, and Visual Editing cards add a condition or reference image. Panel (b) is a two-ring sunburst of the dataset's split by group and type, in the band colours, with the AnyEdit logo in its hole. Band widths shrink down the page to leave room for the chart.
summary_zh: AnyEdit 是含25种编辑类型的大规模指令式图像编辑数据集。图(a)用五条彩色横带分别展示局部、视觉、相机移动、全局、隐式编辑的样例卡片（原图、结果图与指令），图(b)用旭日图展示类型分布，配色与横带对应，中心为数据集标志。
notes: The caption letters (a)-(e) name the five groups and their colours, but the printed figure is lettered (a) examples and (b) distribution, as the text of Section 3 uses it; the caption calls the camera group grey but it is peach in the figure. Counts of thumbnails are estimated from the grid (25 sources, 25 results, 7 condition images); the digest lists 83 bitmaps.
